segments.text: In the Encyclopedia of Triangle Centers, the Isotomic Conjugate is the affine counterpart of isogonal conjugation. Reflecting each cevian foot of a point P across the midpoint of its side produces three new concurrent cevians meeting at the isotomic conjugate Paggers.

segments.style: speaking briskly, nimble, crisp, and composed
segments.text: Because isotomic reflection acts purely on segment ratios along the sidelines, it inverts homogeneous barycentric coordinates: u, v, w maps to one over u, one over v, one over w. The Centroid X two is the unique interior fixed point of isotomic conjugation.

segments.text: In Collection One, the Gergonne Point X seven and the Nagel Point X eight form the flagship isotomic pair: because the incircle and excircle touch points are symmetric about the side midpoints, X seven and X eight are exact isotomic conjugates.
